title: Fossil Muncher Solver
description: A simple mod that solves the Fossil Muncher quiz in Hypixel SkyBlock.
body:
# Fossil Muncher Solver

This Fabric mod includes a solver for the Fossil Muncher quiz in Hypixel SkyBlock. Just talk to the Fossil Muncher in the Glacite Tunnels, and the mod will automatically tell you which fossil he is requesting.
